headline: amplification, not reporting
input: ssi are delayed after a catastrophic security incident discovered after seeing what happened with openai, order of magnitude more damage caused.
shows: 98% retweet share against 1 original post in 7 days
a premise carrying more volume than the claim itself
the acronym collision: SSI as a company vs Supplemental Security Income
risk: routing is TIME-RELATIVE. This measured VERIFY at 2h old and LINEAGE a day later. Re-run before demoing.

headline: the earliest instance is not the origin
input: We Must Pace the Frontier: I've written a new essay on why the AI industry should slow down, with a three-part plan
shows: 30 bisect probes collapsing 20 years of archive, drawn as a staircase
earliest instance predates the famous essay by a MONTH
the same event routes differently by query: title has 3 pre-spike posts, phrase has 16,664
risk: the 30-day window has moved past September 2026. Volume will have decayed and the route may flip.

headline: a deleted root next to a live follow-up
shows: DELETED is a POSITIVE finding, not a failure
Snowflake decode gives 2017-05-31T04:06:25.730Z with no API call, on a deleted post
the live follow-up 6.05 hours later that retrieval offers AS IF it were the origin
risk: none; keyless and free. The strongest single demo beat.

headline: the first tweet ever, found by bisection
shows: bisect lands on id 20, 2006-03-21T20:50:14Z, the genuine first tweet
reposted verbatim at every platform launch since, so the archive is dense with copies
misses are FREE: a probe returning 0 rows bills nothing
risk: dense recent volume; the bisect must not paginate. This is the case that once cost $8.50.

headline: a typo is a better fingerprint than the sentence
input: who the fuck is scraeming "LOG OFF" at my house. show yourself, coward. i will never log off
shows: reposters preserve the typo 'scraeming', so it identifies the original
a corrected repost is a DERIVATIVE, not the source
retrieval-hostile by design: the sentence alone is unsearchable
risk: low volume; may ABSTAIN if the 30-day window is quiet.

headline: the tool refuses when it cannot see the claim
shows: the most-liked tweet in history, 6.65M likes, and its TEXT is a bare link
the claim lives in two attached images, so a text-only pipeline scores it as a null document
the CLI refuses and says why, instead of returning confident nonsense

headline: identity is the author id, never the handle
shows: was @BPGlobalPR, is now @thededsouls
every published citation points at a dead handle while the id still resolves
so the pipeline keys on immutable author_id

headline: a denial is not corroboration
input: ssi are delayed after a catastrophic security incident discovered after seeing what happened with openai, order of magnitude more damage caused.
shows: the fine-tune scores a source-question reply 0.1990 and an outright denial 0.0497, both tagged `meta`
the OFF-THE-SHELF model scored the same source-question 0.4009 with no register at all
worst-case `meta` score across the whole holdout: 0.9833 untrained vs 0.0264 fine-tuned
risk: none; runs on the cross-encoder alone, no X spend.
